reviewer_summary.question: Why can the model process all the prompt pieces together but choose the answer only one piece at a time?
reviewer_summary.takeaway: The prompt pieces are already available, whereas choosing the piece after blue requires putting blue through the layers first; the cache keeps earlier keys and values for reuse.
